question.text: Portfolio return 10.5%, risk-free 5.5%, sigma 6.5%. Sharpe ratio (approx):

explanation.text: The Logic: Sharpe = (10.5 - 5.5)/6.5 = 5/6.5 = 0.7692. The Trap: Other values come from arithmetic errors. Cross-Exam Context: Workbook example. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Benchmark Sharpe >= 0.7 is broadly considered good for equity PMs.
